recipes.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Counter target sorcery spell.
• Destroy target creature with power 2 or less.
• Look at the top three cards of target player's library. Put one back and the rest into that player's graveyard.

recipe_coverage: Complete source identity and Oracle text are pinned. Actual parent and response casts use stack1/stack2 and normal legality, payment and selection for both controllers. Tests cover printed fixed or derived taxes, pay/decline/exact/unaffordable decisions, source costs and missing resources, typed targets, own/opposing spells, selected/unselected permanents, exact zone multiplicities and ordered libraries, and snapshot replay as applicable. Destroy-creature and library-selection modes are not selected. Invalid counter-mode availability when another mode is legal remains untested. Countered response sources, lost targets, replacement/prevention, simultaneous responses and multiplayer remain separate gaps.
